title: Thorough, objective probe into fatal PAF plane crash ongoing --DND
summary: The Department of National Defense said Monday that a thorough and objective investigation is being conducted into the fatal crash that resulted in the death of four pilots during a training flight…

blocks.text: The Department of National Defense said Monday that a thorough and objective investigation is being conducted into the fatal plane crash that resulted in the death of four pilots during a training flight over Fernando Air Base in Lipa City, Batangas.

"An investigation is ongoing and will be conducted thoroughly and objectively to establish the facts, determine the causes, and identify any gaps that require corrective action and prevent similar tragedies," the DND said in a statement.
"The DND remains committed to transparency, accountability, and ensuring the safety of our personnel," it added.
It said it mourns the tragic loss of four Philippine Air Force pilots in the SF-260 aircraft accident.

"We extend our heartfelt condolences to their grieving families, loved ones, friends, and fellow airmen and women who share in this profound loss. Their service and sacrifice for the nation will not be forgotten," the DND said.
The incident happened at 3:51 p.m. on Friday, October 23.
Two single-propeller SF-260 aircraft were involved, with both of them going down within the base perimeter.
Video footage obtained by GMA News showed the two aircraft colliding in midair. —AOL, GMA News
